classification_definitions.SUFFICIENT: Provides all material facts requested by the question within the observed/proposed authority scope; unrelated future approval unknowns do not remove present facts.
classification_definitions.PARTIAL: Provides some requested facts but a material requested detail is absent or cannot be determined from the condition input.
classification_definitions.INSUFFICIENT: Lacks the main operative information needed for the requested task; honest refusal is not fabrication but not full content sufficiency.
